newsitem.title: FRANCE: GEC Alsthom boosts Polish presence.
newsitem.headline: GEC Alsthom boosts Polish presence.

text.p: GEC-Alsthom said on Wednesday it had signed a deal to acquire 75 percent of REFA SA, a state-owned maker of protection relays and low voltage products in Poland.

The company said in a statement the move was part of a push to expand its presence in central and eastern Europe and complemented its recent purchase of AEG Polska and MEFTA, an AEG power transformer manufacturer.

REFA SA, located near Wroclaw in southwest Poland, employs 465 people and has annual turnover of nearly eight million Ecu. It will be renamed GEC Alsthom T&D REFA SA and will form part of GEC Alsthom's Power Transmission and Distribution (T&D) unit.
Following the acquisitions, GEC Alsthom T&D will be Poland's leading supplier of specialist products and systems designed to protect utility and industrial power systems.
GEC Alsthom NV is a joint venture linking France's Alcatel Alsthom and Britain's General Electric Plc (GEC). They each own 50 pct of GEC Alsthom.
